youtube_description: On Thursday October 17, RCMP officers with assault rifles assaulted a peaceful protest in Rexton against shale gas exploration and arrested 40 people.  This interview with several people at the Moncton courthouse may be of interest to those who wish to understand the situation.
youtube_title: An interview with the MLA from Irvingland
